title: Jammy Moroccan Flour Bake
description: A comforting, flavorful bake perfect for brunch with a rich jammy topping and a crunchy bonito topping

ingredients.name: Bakery-quality jam
ingredients.notes: use your favorite flavor, such as apricot or orange marmalade

instructions: Mix together the wholemeal flour, sugar, cinnamon, cardamom and salt in a large bowl.
Add the unsalted butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a greased, 20cm (8in) round cake pan.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt and bakery-quality jam until smooth.
Pour the yogurt mixture over the flour mixture in the cake pan and smooth the top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly.
Remove the cake from the oven and brush the beaten egg over the top for a golden glaze.
Return the cake to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the egg is golden brown.
Remove the cake from the oven and sprinkle the bonito flakes over the top.
Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the cake into 8-10 servings and serve warm, topped with additional bakery-quality jam if desired
